# Cncf Kots Reviewer

Review KOTS using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. KOTS provides the framework, tools and integrations that enable the delivery and management of 3rd-party Kubernetes applications, a.k.a. Kubernetes Off-The-Shelf (KOTS) Software.&#39;

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
